name: Bitter Cold Night

text.trigger: A survivor takes frostbite on the exposure roll after a move, and arrives where other survivors already are.
text.vignette: Ice has sealed the seams of the doorframe and the wind keeps trying every gap. Behind the door a small group has a stove barely warm enough to matter, and outside a half-frozen traveller is scratching at the wood.

options.let-them-in: Open up: the draught reaches everyone, and every survivor at the location takes a frostbite wound.
options.bar-the-door: Keep it shut: the traveller does not survive the night, and the moving survivor is killed.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #45; trigger counts the arriving survivor, so 2 or more at the location means 1 or more were already there
